deviations.what: The smoke test copies the start step into the container with docker cp instead of mounting it.
deviations.why: Docker Desktop with docker.exe gives the container an empty directory when a WSL path is bind-mounted.

deviations.what: In docker-compose.yml the worker waits for django to be healthy, and django has a healthcheck. The plan has neither.
deviations.why: Both services ran uv sync into the shared venv volume at once; the web service failed and the worker started without celery.

concerns: Docker Desktop resolves a relative bind mount (.:/app) to a \\wsl.localhost path, but an absolute WSL path in -v arrives empty. The documented compose files use the relative form, which works.
